svg.title: Sound Creations Ltd Company Profile 2026 - Page 08

text.tspan: The auditorium’s acoustic, audio and visual design was inspired by the school’s
mission of nurturing the whole child. Side walls feature tree-shaped acoustic
absorbers from TianGe Acoustic, adorned with rainbow LED lighting. A curved
acoustic ceiling reflects sound from the stage evenly across the audience,
complemented by acoustic seats, acoustic carpet and a fully treated back wall. The
result unites acoustics, sound and light into a bespoke, inspiring space.
NEXO ID-series and Yamaha DZR loudspeakers
Shure wireless: QLXD, ULXD, MX and SM series
TianGe tree-shaped absorbers with rainbow LED
